itemAcid.name: Acid
itemAcid.description: Offensive - Slow enemies and corrode the battlefield

itemBanjo.name: Banjo
itemBanjo.description:
Slow and weak attacks, some healing power.
Perfect for healing your allies while destroying their eardrums.

itemBoomerang.name: Boomerang
itemBoomerang.description:
Flies out, bullies enemies for a while, then swings back for another round. 
No ammo needed, perfect for an eco-friendly loadout.

itemBow.name: Bow
itemBow.description:
Fires bargain-bin arrows when you quick draw. 
Bend it like you mean it to drop an explosive banger.

itemCactus.name: Cactus
itemCactus.description: Utility - Control the battlefield by summoning helpful cacti

itemDualRevolver.name: Dual Revolvers
itemDualRevolver.description: High fire rate, bad accuracy, yet one reload sends both revolvers soaring into explosive usefulness. A miraculous jump from meh to mayhem.

itemElec.name: Elec
itemElec.description: Utility - Move fast and strike enemies with lightning

itemFire.name: Pyro
itemFire.description: Offensive - Burn enemies and set the ground ablaze

itemIce.name: Frost
itemIce.description: Defensive - Freeze enemies and reinforce your shield

itemKnuckles.name: Knuckles
itemKnuckles.description:
Short range, big impact.
Requires no ammo, no aim, and no thoughts.

itemLasso.name: Lasso
itemLasso.description:
Whips enemies fast at a decent reach.
Some of them come back for more, and not out of spite.

itemLongRanger.name: Long Ranger
itemLongRanger.description: Built for unmatched accuracy and piercing shots, every miss dishonors centuries of craftsmanship. Try not to be disappointing.

itemMinigun.name: Minigun
itemMinigun.description: Once it spins up, this thing spews bullets nonstop. Technically stoppable, but you're a full-time bullet-slinger, not some quitter.

itemPistol.name: Revolver
itemPistol.description:
Reliable at all times, average at everything. 
Peak choice for people who fear commitment.

itemQuadCylinder.name: Quad Cylinder
itemQuadCylinder.description:
Shoots fine, feels fine, does fine. 
A monument to mediocrity, but a very dependable one.

itemSheriffStar.name: Sheriff Star
itemSheriffStar.description:
Launches at high speed and slices enemies. 
Justice has never been this low-effort.

itemShotgun.name: Shotgun
itemShotgun.description: Weirdly high fire rate for a shotgun, single-shell reloads, and a spread wildfires wish for. At last, a weapon that matches your aim.

itemSpellAcidBubble.name: Bubble
itemSpellAcidBubble.description: Throw a big acid bubble that bursts on impact and creates multiple acid puddles.

itemSpellAcidContagion.name: Contagion
itemSpellAcidContagion.description: Corrodes all enemies in a wide zone and applies Contagious, causing them to explode on death.

itemSpellAcidGeyser.name: Geyser
itemSpellAcidGeyser.description: Summon an acid geyser that erupts on impact.

itemSpellAcidRain.name: Rain
itemSpellAcidRain.description: Call down a rain of acid that corrodes enemies in a wide area.

itemSpellAcidThrower.name: Thrower
itemSpellAcidThrower.description: Spit jets of acid that leave corrosive puddles on the ground.

itemSpellCactusBetty.name: Mino
itemSpellCactusBetty.description: Summon a cactus mine that explodes when stepped on.

itemSpellCactusDecoy.name: Decoyo
itemSpellCactusDecoy.description: Summon a dancing cactus that lures enemies before exploding.

itemSpellCactusTurret.name: Pistolero
itemSpellCactusTurret.description: Summon a cactus turret that fires continuously at nearby enemies.

itemSpellCactusUlti.name: Bandito
itemSpellCactusUlti.description: Summon a powerful cactus golem that fights for you for a while.

itemSpellCactusWall.name: Wallo
itemSpellCactusWall.description: Summon cactus spikes that damage and slow enemies on contact.

itemSpellElecPortal.name: Portal
itemSpellElecPortal.description: Spawn up to two portals that teleport players and duplicate spell projectiles.

itemSpellElecStrike.name: Strikes
itemSpellElecStrike.description: Launch a line of lightning strikes that zap everything in their path.

itemSpellElecSuperJump.name: Boing
itemSpellElecSuperJump.description: Instantly jump to escape your enemies.

itemSpellElecSwap.name: Swap
itemSpellElecSwap.description: Swap positions with an enemy, exploding at both locations.

itemSpellElecThunderstrike.name: Thunderstrike
itemSpellElecThunderstrike.description: Rise up, then dive down to blast the area and unleash thunder over your enemies.

itemSpellFireBall.name: Fireball
itemSpellFireBall.description: Launch a fireball that explodes on impact and leaves the ground burning.

itemSpellFireBeam.name: Firebeam
itemSpellFireBeam.description: Unleash a giant fire beam that scorches everything.

itemSpellFireFingergun.name: Finger Guns
itemSpellFireFingergun.description: Swap your weapon for fiery fingers that shoot explosive fire bullets.

itemSpellFireSurcharge.name: Surcharge
itemSpellFireSurcharge.description: Burn all enemies in a wide zone, detonating those already ablaze.

itemSpellFireWisp.name: Wisp
itemSpellFireWisp.description: Summon a wisp that deals extra burn damage, jumping to another enemy on kill.

itemSpellIceBlizzard.name: Blizzard
itemSpellIceBlizzard.description: Summon a blizzard that follows you, dealing damage to all enemies and shielding allies.

itemSpellIceBreeze.name: Breeze
itemSpellIceBreeze.description: Summon a breeze that freezes enemies in a wide cone.

itemSpellIceCube.name: Cube
itemSpellIceCube.description: Turn yourself or an ally into an invulnerable ice cube.

itemSpellIceGlaze.name: Glaze
itemSpellIceGlaze.description: Release a burst, dealing damage to nearby enemies and shielding nearby allies.

itemSpellIceLance.name: Bridge
itemSpellIceLance.description: Summon a bridge that shields allies who cross it.

itemSpellVoodooCorruption.name: Corruption
itemSpellVoodooCorruption.description: Channel a doll to corrupt enemies, making them fight for you.

itemSpellVoodooDoll.name: Doll
itemSpellVoodooDoll.description: Summon a doll that grants invincibility and high speed to allies within its zone.

itemSpellVoodooDrain.name: Drain
itemSpellVoodooDrain.description: Command your doll to drain an enemy's health.

itemSpellVoodooHeal.name: Rescue
itemSpellVoodooHeal.description: Channel your doll's power to heal or revive the nearest ally.

itemSpellVoodooHealArea.name: Ritual
itemSpellVoodooHealArea.description: Summon a ring of candles that restores the health of allies within its light.

itemUtilityAmmo.name: Ammo Pack
itemUtilityAmmo.description:
Explodes into ammo. More players means more bullets. 
Family gatherings have never been so lucrative.

itemUtilityBottleCrate.name: Bottle Crate
itemUtilityBottleCrate.description:
Explodes into healing bottles.
Guaranteed to make you the most popular cowboy at the saloon.

itemUtilityHealBottle.name: Healing Area
itemUtilityHealBottle.description:
Explodes on impact and creates a healing zone that lasts for a long time. 
Smells like rotten soup, just like any proper grandma's remedy.

itemUtilityImpulse.name: Impulse Grenade
itemUtilityImpulse.description:
Periodically generates shockwaves that push players away. 
Allows you to reach heights your skill level never will.

itemVoodoo.name: Voodoo
itemVoodoo.description: Utility - Drain enemy life and support allies

itemWinchester.name: Leveredge
itemWinchester.description:
Crisp lever action, flawless precision, and rugged reloads. 
Once used to win sickly goldfish at the fair, now wins gunfights.

jokerAimingBurst.name: AIMING BURST
jokerAimingBurst.description: +30% weakspot damage and piercing bullets while aiming

jokerAllMighty.name: ALL MIGHTY
jokerAllMighty.description: Gain +1% damage per 1 shield point, up to 80%

jokerAmmoSupply.name: AMMO SUPPLY
jokerAmmoSupply.description: +5% chance for enemies to drop an ammo box upon death

jokerAntiGravityFalls.name: ANTI-GRAVITY FALLS
jokerAntiGravityFalls.description: +2% chance to spawn an anti-gravity area when an enemy dies

jokerBardbarian.name: BARDBARIAN
jokerBardbarian.description: Hold the slam attack longer to release a more powerful blow

jokerBattleMage.name: BATTLEMAGE
jokerBattleMage.description: Killing an enemy shortens all ongoing spell cooldowns by 0.5%

jokerBellShot.name: BELL SHOT
jokerBellShot.description: +5% chance for weakspot hits to summon a healing ghost bell

jokerBerserker.name: BERSERKER
jokerBerserker.description: Gain up to +50% melee damage as your HP gets lower

jokerBloodLust.name: BLOODLUST
jokerBloodLust.description: Melee kills grant a stacking +5% melee speed for 5 sec., up to +50%

jokerCactusDay.name: CACTUS DAY
jokerCactusDay.description: +5% chance for a Cactus Mino to spawn when an enemy dies

jokerCamper.name: CAMPER
jokerCamper.description: +50% chance not to consume ammo while standing still

jokerCantRipOneTrick.name: CANTRIP ONE-TRICK
jokerCantRipOneTrick.description: Spells with base cooldowns of 35s or less gain -25% spell cooldown

jokerCastAway.name: CAST AWAY
jokerCastAway.description: Casting a spell decreases the spell cooldown of other spells by 3 sec. to a minimum of 4 sec.

jokerCdrAcid.name: ACID MASTERY
jokerCdrAcid.description: Gain -10% Acid spells cooldown per equipped Acid spell

jokerCdrCactus.name: CACTUS MASTERY
jokerCdrCactus.description: Gain -10% Cactus spells cooldown per equipped Cactus spell

jokerCdrElec.name: ELEC MASTERY
jokerCdrElec.description: Gain -10% Elec spells cooldown per equipped Elec spell

jokerCdrFire.name: PYRO MASTERY
jokerCdrFire.description: Gain -10% Pyro spells cooldown per equipped Pyro spell

jokerCdrFrost.name: FROST MASTERY
jokerCdrFrost.description: Gain -10% Frost spells cooldown per equipped Frost spell

jokerCdrVoodoo.name: VOODOO MASTERY
jokerCdrVoodoo.description: Gain -10% Voodoo spells cooldown per equipped Voodoo spell

jokerChad.name: CHAD
jokerChad.description: Reveals the position of the Wandering Trader and get a 20% discount. You deserve it

jokerCheapSkate.name: CHEAPSKATE
jokerCheapSkate.description: Gain +1 HP for every 20 Gold in your mission inventory, up to +15 HP

jokerChickshot.name: CHICKSHOT
jokerChickshot.description: +50% chance for attacks to make chicken sounds. Useless!

jokerChonkyThrow.name: CHONKY THROW
jokerChonkyThrow.description: The boomerang is twice as big and passes through the shields

jokerClutch.name: CLUTCH
jokerClutch.description: +2 explosive bullets at the end of your magazine

jokerCoinFlip.name: COINFLIP
jokerCoinFlip.description: Flip a coin every 10 sec. You either deal +100% or -50% weapon damage

jokerColdBlooded.name: COLD BLOODED
jokerColdBlooded.description: Your melee attacks freeze enemies, consuming 3 shield points per enemy

jokerConsumer.name: CONSUMER
jokerConsumer.description: Grants +25% weapon damage, but reloading now wastes unused ammo

jokerDeadlyStrong.name: DEADLY STRONG
jokerDeadlyStrong.description: Move faster and deal more damage as a dead ghost

jokerDestroyer.name: DESTROYER
jokerDestroyer.description: The first 25% of your clip deals +20% damage

jokerDisgrace.name: DISGRACE
jokerDisgrace.description: Gain +30% movement speed. Your horse does not want to be with you

jokerDoubleDown.name: DOUBLE DOWN
jokerDoubleDown.description: Gain +30% shield points from all sources

jokerDwarf.name: DWARF
jokerDwarf.description: You are small. Gain movespeed, attack speed and lower gravity

jokerEagleLever.name: EAGLE LEVER
jokerEagleLever.description: Consecutive shots without missing grant +10% damage, stacking up to +50%

jokerEatAPunch.name: EAT-A-PUNCH
jokerEatAPunch.description: Melee kills heal you for 2 HP

jokerElementalSpin.name: ELEMENTAL SPIN
jokerElementalSpin.description: The minigun has a 30% chance to fire a random elemental bullet instead of a regular one

jokerExecute.name: EXECUTE
jokerExecute.description: Your hits instantly kill enemies below 20% HP, except elites and bosses

jokerExplosiveRounds.name: EXPLOSIVE HITS (Pyro)
jokerExplosiveRounds.description: +5% chance for your hits to cause an explosion (Pyro)

jokerExplosiveRoundsAcid.name: EXPLOSIVE HITS (Acid)
jokerExplosiveRoundsAcid.description: +5% chance for your hits to cause an explosion (Acid)

jokerExplosiveRoundsElec.name: EXPLOSIVE HITS (Elec)
jokerExplosiveRoundsElec.description: +5% chance for your hits to cause an explosion (Elec)

jokerExplosiveRoundsFrost.name: EXPLOSIVE HITS (Frost)
jokerExplosiveRoundsFrost.description: +5% chance for your hits to cause an explosion (Frost)

jokerFanningAce.name: FANNING ACE
jokerFanningAce.description: Fire mid-reload at the right moment to chain-fire all bullets

jokerFastDraw.name: SWITCHSHOT
jokerFastDraw.description: Your first hit after equipping a weapon deals 30% more damage

jokerFightOrFlight.name: FIGHT OR FLIGHT
jokerFightOrFlight.description: Taking HP damage grants +20% melee speed for 3 sec.

jokerFistFight.name: FIST FIGHT
jokerFistFight.description: Your bare hands hits are more powerful

jokerFistRage.name: FIST RAGE
jokerFistRage.description: Taking damage generates charge and grants +30% attack speed for 2 sec.

jokerFistRoDah.name: FIST RO DAH
jokerFistRoDah.description: The charged attack propels you backwards and has a 20% chance to apply Frost to enemies

jokerFocusShot.name: FOCUS SHOT
jokerFocusShot.description: Every weakspot hit reduces the cooldown of your spells by 2 sec.

jokerFreeCocktail.name: FREE COCKTAIL
jokerFreeCocktail.description: When you reload an empty clip, heal for 2 HP

jokerFreezeOver.name: LAST BASTION
jokerFreezeOver.description: Upon reaching 25% HP, gain +50 shield (cooldown: 60 sec.)

jokerFrenzySpin.name: FRENZY SPIN
jokerFrenzySpin.description: While your kill counter is above 10, the minigun fires twice as fast

jokerFrostBite.name: FROST BITE
jokerFrostBite.description: Melee kills on frozen enemies grant 2 shield points

jokerGiant.name: GIANT
jokerGiant.description: You are big. Gain health, weapon damage and spell cooldown reduction

jokerGlassCannon.name: GLASS CANNON
jokerGlassCannon.description: +40% weapon and melee damage, but -25% HP

jokerGoldProspector.name: GOLD PROSPECTOR
jokerGoldProspector.description: Increase your acquired Gold by 20% at the end of a mission

jokerGoldTooth.name: GOLD TOOTH
jokerGoldTooth.description: +10% chance for enemies to drop 1 gold nugget upon death

jokerGreatWall.name: GREAT WALL
jokerGreatWall.description: Reduce all damage taken by 10% when shielded

jokerHeadshotRefund.name: WEAKSPOT REFUND
jokerHeadshotRefund.description: +20% chance to get your ammo back after a weakspot hit

jokerHealthyBoi.name: HEALTHY BOI
jokerHealthyBoi.description: While at full HP, gain +20% move speed, reload speed, and attack speed

jokerHeavyDrinker.name: HEAVY DRINKER
jokerHeavyDrinker.description: Healing bottles are 25% more effective on you

jokerHeavyWeapon.name: HEAVY WEAPON
jokerHeavyWeapon.description: +10% damage, but +30% gravity while the weapon is active

jokerHelpingHand.name: HELPING HAND
jokerHelpingHand.description: You can revive your allies twice as fast

jokerHitMe.name: HIT ME
jokerHitMe.description: Heal 0.75 HP per second for 20 sec. after being hit

jokerHoarder.name: HOARDER
jokerHoarder.description: +15% chance that collecting a Joker makes another random one appear

jokerHomingBurst.name: HOMING BURST
jokerHomingBurst.description: Every 8 bullets fired, shoot 2 homing bullets at nearby enemies

jokerJokheal.name: MEDICARD
jokerJokheal.description: Picking up a joker heals for a bonus +35HP

jokerJumpStar.name: JUMP STAR
jokerJumpStar.description: +2 Jumps while holding the Sheriff Stars

jokerLastDance.name: LAST DANCE
jokerLastDance.description: While at or below 30% HP, gain +30% move speed

jokerLastStand.name: LAST STAND
jokerLastStand.description: While at or below 30% HP, reduce all damage taken by -30% and gain 10% melee lifesteal

jokerLazy.name: LAZY
jokerLazy.description: Ammo pickups are disabled. Gain 10% of max ammo every 12 sec.

jokerLifePact.name: LIFE PACT
jokerLifePact.description: Kills heal you for 2 HP, but max. HP is reduced by 30%

jokerLingeringThrow.name: LINGERING THROW
jokerLingeringThrow.description: Doubles the lingering time. Combines with Lingering Time upgrade

jokerLuckyStrike.name: LUCKY STRIKE
jokerLuckyStrike.description: +10% chance to deal double damage per hit

jokerLullabard.name: LULLABARD
jokerLullabard.description: Gain an extra chord per hit and a wider healing zone, but lose the slam attack

jokerMachineGun.name: MACHINE GUN
jokerMachineGun.description: Per mission, the weapon gains +0.3% attack speed for every 50 damage dealt

jokerMagicFriendship.name: MAGIC FRIENDSHIP
jokerMagicFriendship.description: Passively regain HP while being near allies

jokerMagicReload.name: MAGIC RELOAD
jokerMagicReload.description: Automatically reload your weapon after casting a spell

jokerMarkAce.name: MARK ACE
jokerMarkAce.description: Bullets mark enemies for 5 sec. Marked enemies take +15% damage

jokerOneTrick.name: JOKER TRICK
jokerOneTrick.description: Gain +7% damage and attack speed for every distinct joker rarity equipped on the weapon

jokerOverBlast.name: OVERBLAST
jokerOverBlast.description: Shoots an extra pellet for every 4 missing shots in the magazine

jokerOverDraw.name: OVERDRAW
jokerOverDraw.description: Charge for 2 sec. to fire 3 arrows in a cone. Attack speed reduces charge time

jokerPanicAttack.name: PANIC ATTACK
jokerPanicAttack.description: When you take HP damage, gain +20% damage for 3 sec.

jokerPartyShot.name: PARTY SHOT
jokerPartyShot.description: +50% chance for weakspot hits to blow confetti. Useless!

jokerPickPick.name: PICK PICK
jokerPickPick.description: +10% chance on hit to spawn damaging pickaxes on the target

jokerPigshot.name: PIGSHOT
jokerPigshot.description: +5% chance to spawn a pig on impact. Attack them to make them explode

jokerPlasticDuck.name: RUBBER DUCK
jokerPlasticDuck.description: Walking makes rubber duck noises. Useless!

jokerPreciousRush.name: PRECIOUS RUSH
jokerPreciousRush.description: +10% chance for a speed-boosting ring to spawn when an enemy dies

jokerPricklyPear.name: PRICKLY PEAR
jokerPricklyPear.description: When HP hit, deal the same damage +15 back to the attacker

jokerRage.name: RAGE
jokerRage.description: Upon reaching 25% HP, release a wave that burns nearby enemies (cooldown: 60 sec.)

jokerRampage.name: RAMPAGE
jokerRampage.description: Gain 5% reload speed on kill for 10 sec., up to 100%

jokerRelentless.name: RELENTLESS
jokerRelentless.description: While at or below 30% HP, deal +30% damage

jokerReloadMastery.name: RELOAD MASTERY
jokerReloadMastery.description: Reloading an empty clip is 50% faster

jokerRicochet.name: RICOCHET
jokerRicochet.description: The fired bullet ricochets, with a 30% chance to automatically hit a nearby enemy

jokerRiposte.name: RIPOSTE
jokerRiposte.description: After your shield absorbs a hit, your next attack deals +100% damage

jokerRushBlast.name: RUSH BLAST
jokerRushBlast.description: The first 3 bullets in your magazine have 100% accuracy and shoot further away

jokerScavengerStar.name: SCAVENGER STAR
jokerScavengerStar.description: Gain +100% pickup range. Gain +30% move speed while holding the Sheriff Stars

jokerScoutsHonor.name: SCOUT'S HONOR
jokerScoutsHonor.description: After 10 sec. without taking damage, your shield is set to a minimum of 10 shield points

jokerScrubBullet.name: SCRUB HIT
jokerScrubBullet.description: Your primary weapon removes elements from enemies to instantly deal 10 damage

jokerSecondWind.name: SECOND WIND
jokerSecondWind.description: Heal 50 HP instead of dying to a fatal hit (cooldown: 180 sec.)

jokerShroomGrave.name: SHROOM GRAVE
jokerShroomGrave.description: +10% chance for a shroom to spawn when an enemy dies

jokerSkyLash.name: SKY LASH
jokerSkyLash.description: The charged attack grants +50% move speed and lets you fly

jokerSnackAPunch.name: SNACK-A-PUNCH
jokerSnackAPunch.description: Melee kills grant you 1 shield points

jokerSoulEater.name: SOUL EATER
jokerSoulEater.description: Picking up a soul grants 20% damage and reload speed for 5 sec.

jokerSoulReaper.name: SOUL REAPER
jokerSoulReaper.description: Increase your acquired Souls by 20% at the end of a mission

jokerSoulSiphon.name: SOUL SIPHON
jokerSoulSiphon.description: Increased pick up range and heals for +2 HP when picking up a soul

jokerSpeedster.name: SPEEDSTER
jokerSpeedster.description: +1% damage and attack speed per 3% bonus move speed, up to +40%

jokerSpellLash.name: SPELL LASH
jokerSpellLash.description: Casting a spell instantly fills your charge bar

jokerSpellRoulette.name: SPELL ROULETTE
jokerSpellRoulette.description: -20% spell cooldown, but spells are randomized on each cast

jokerStackedLever.name: STACKED LEVER
jokerStackedLever.description: Instantly reload 2 bullets from your reserve ammo on kill

jokerStonks.name: STONKS
jokerStonks.description: +20% chance that opening a chest gives you a random Joker

jokerSwampTrick.name: SWAMP TRICK
jokerSwampTrick.description: Reload explosions now leave puddles on the ground

jokerThickSkin.name: THICK SKIN
jokerThickSkin.description: Reduce all damage taken by 20%, but receive -30% healing

jokerTinMan.name: TIN MAN
jokerTinMan.description: Excess healing converts into shield points, up to +15 SP

jokerToolBox.name: TOOLBOX
jokerToolBox.description: Utility pickups are disabled. Your utility automatically refills after 90 sec.

jokerTweakDealer.name: JOKER DEALER
jokerTweakDealer.description: Gain +1 HP for each active Joker

jokerUltraDraw.name: ULTRA DRAW
jokerUltraDraw.description: Charge for 4 sec. to fire a massive explosive arrow. Attack speed reduces charge time

jokerWeakLink.name: WEAK LINK
jokerWeakLink.description: +35% weakspot damage, but -20% regular hits damage
